# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the sticker or repository change and link the related issue.

## Sticker checks

- [ ] Source artwork and print export are included in `stickers/<slug>/`.
- [ ] `metadata.yaml` matches the README schema and the gallery row.
- [ ] I can publish the artwork under its stated licence.
- [ ] The gallery preview renders.
- [ ] The buy link opens the published listing for this design, or the row clearly says “Listing pending”.
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes.
